verdict.rationale: The Agent API can analyze data you supply. Its sandbox tool runs real code to produce exact results such as a transformed dataset or generated report, the typed-answer API classifies text and images, and agents can call your own remote MCP server to reach your data. However, the product is a web-grounded AI API rather than an app that holds your data and surfaces insights or suggestions inside its own interface. missing for 10: native analysis of stored user data inside the product, proactive insight/suggestion features, hands-on or independent corroboration of data-analysis use.
